material_scope: Single reported pipe stock, normalized 1040 C for 20 min; tempered 780 C for 120 min
failure_definition: Author-defined 10 percent drop of peak stress (Figure 2); not assumed rupture or a specified crack size
strain_measure: total axial strain range, not amplitude
loading: strain-controlled trapezoid with peak tensile strain hold
split_scope: Within-source held-out intermediate dwell; not a different batch or external validation

source_overlap_audit.decision: Identical conditions and lives; exclude from independent validation unless specimen independence is established
source_overlap_audit.identity_status: Potential reused observations, not proven distinct specimens
